classification.difficultyReason: Derives a cylinder volume rate and recognises that the circumference rate is independent of radius.

content.prompt: A lathe is used to shave down the radius of a cylindrical piece of wood 500 mm long. The radius is decreasing at a rate of 3 mm/min.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Show that the rate of change of volume is $\dfrac{dV}{dt}=-3000\pi r$, and find how fast the volume is decreasing when the radius is 30 mm.

answer.short: $\dfrac{dV}{dt}=-3000\pi r$. At $r=30\text{ mm}$, the volume decreases at $90000\pi\text{ mm}^3\!/\text{min}$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}V&=\pi r^2(500)\\V&=500\pi r^2\\\frac{dV}{dt}&=\frac{dV}{dr}\frac{dr}{dt}\\\frac{dV}{dt}&=1000\pi r(-3)\\\frac{dV}{dt}&=-3000\pi r\end{aligned}$$
When $r=30\text{ mm}$,
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{dV}{dt}&=-3000\pi(30)\\\frac{dV}{dt}&=-90000\pi\text{ mm}^3\!/\text{min}.\end{aligned}$$
The volume decreases at $90000\pi\text{ mm}^3\!/\text{min}$.

$$\begin{aligned}C&=2\pi r\\\frac{dC}{dt}&=\frac{dC}{dr}\frac{dr}{dt}\\\frac{dC}{dt}&=2\pi(-3)\\\frac{dC}{dt}&=-6\pi\text{ mm/min}.\end{aligned}$$
The circumference decreases at $6\pi\text{ mm/min}$.

$$\begin{aligned}\frac{dC}{dt}&=2\pi\frac{dr}{dt}\\\frac{dC}{dt}&=2\pi(-3)\\\frac{dC}{dt}&=-6\pi\text{ mm/min}.\end{aligned}$$
The rate is independent of the radius, so the circumference also decreases at $6\pi\text{ mm/min}$ when $r=37\text{ mm}$.
